normalize_xarray_dataset: normalize an xarray Dataset using provided scales and optional locations for zero-mean unit variance
unnormalize_xarray_dataset: unnormalize an xarray Dataset by multiplying with scales and adding locations to restore original values
create_inputs_and_residuals_predictor: create an InputsAndResiduals predictor wrapper that normalizes inputs and predicts normalized residuals with a residual connection
compute_loss_on_normalized_data: compute the loss on normalized inputs and target residuals using the InputsAndResiduals predictor wrapper
get_loss_and_predictions_normalized: get both loss and unnormalized predictions from the InputsAndResiduals wrapper by calling loss_and_predictions
